source: 685 Illusion
target: 685 Illusio

source: Outside Tizamo, near the entrance to the forest, Lumian and his companions heard gunshots and shouts echoing from the direction of the military camp.
target: Extra Tizamo, prope aditum ad silvam, Lumian et comitēs eius sonitus sclopetorum acclamationumque ex regione castri militāri resonantes audiverunt.

source: The population was denser here compared to the town and plantations, and more heavily armed.
target: Hic incolārum densitas, comparāta cum oppidō et plantationibus, maior erat, et melius armātī erant.

source: Many lives were lost each year in this area.
target: Multae vitāe singulīs annīs in hac regione perierunt.

source: Camus retracted his gaze and let out a sigh of resignation, like a world‐weary middle‐aged man.
target: Camus oculōs retrāxit et suspirium resignationis edidit, velut vir medīae aetātis, mundo fessa.

source: He knew he was powerless to stop the violence.
target: Sciebat se vim violentiae prohibēre nōn posse.

source: His only hope was to find a way to end the Dream Festival as quickly as possible, so that more people might survive.
target: Unīca eius spes erat viam inveniendi ad Festum Somniorum quam celerrime finendum, ut plūrēs superessent.

source: This was why he had chosen to follow Louis Berry to the black ancient tomb.
target: Idcirco elegit se sequerī Louis Berry ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

source: If Camus were alone, the rational choice would be to find a secluded corner and hide until dawn, until the Dream Festival concluded—just like Kolobo planned to do.
target: Sī Camus sōlus esset, optiō ratiōnābilis esset angulum remotum inveniendō et se celāre usque ad aurōram, donec Festum Somniorum finīretur—sicut Kolobo consiliāverat.

source: However, after witnessing Louis Berry’s formidable strength and realizing the adventurer was willing to take the risk of approaching the black ancient tomb, Camus felt compelled to take action himself.
target: Tamen, postquam vim formidābilis Louis Berry visus est et intellexit adventarium perīculum capere ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum appropinquare, Camus se īpsum ad agendum compellītus sensit.

source: Lumian gazed ahead, trailing Amandina’s light footsteps as she turned onto a narrow path threading into the forest.
target: Lumian ante ōculos spectābat, vestigia levia Amandinae sequerens, dum illa in angustum semitām in silvam convolūtam intrābat.

source: He harbored no illusions about single-handedly putting an end to the Dream Festival.
target: Nullās habebat illūsiōnēs de sē sōlō Festum Somniorum conclusūrum esse.

source: His objectives for this mission had always been clear: Find the gold Hisoka had obtained, along with the item he had procured from the Nois family’s Demon.
target: Scopōs eius huius missionis semper clārōs fuisse: aurum, quod Hisoka adeptus erat, atque rem quam a dāemone familiæ Nois obtinerat, reperīre.

source: Uncover what the key April Fool’s member was scheming, to prevent Hisoka’s legacy from materializing.
target: Detegere quid membrum Aprilis Stultōrum consilium teneret, nē legātum Hisoka materialiter exsisteret.

source: This was both the duty of a Tarot Club Minor Arcana card holder, and a reflection of Lumian’s wariness towards Hisoka.
target: Hoc tum erat officium tenentis chartam Minōris Arcanae in Tarot Club, tum imāgo sollicitae vigilantiae Lumiani erga Hisoka.

source: After discovering the dream projection Hisoka had left behind, Lumian feared his adversary might exploit pre-arranged measures and the dream projection to resurrect himself to some degree during the Dream Festival, returning to the real world as a Wraith or evil spirit.
target: Postquam proiēctiōnem somnī, quam Hisoka relīquīerat, invēnīt, Lumian timuit adversārium suum praeordināta consilia et illam proiēctiōnem ad se aliquatenus reviviscendō in Festō Somniorum adhibēri posse, redeundum in mundum rēā ut umbra aut spiritus maleficus.

source: He was determined not to give Hisoka that chance.
target: Statuĕre volebat nē Hisoka illam occāsiōnem tribueret.

source: After hearing Padre Cali’s confession, Lumian’s suspicions only intensified.
target: Post audītam confessionem Padre Cali, suspītiōnēs Lumiani sōlū intensae sunt.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Hisoka returned to Tizamo each year to participate in the Dream Festival.
target: Hisoka quotanniēs ad Tizamo redibat ut in Festō Somniorum particiPARet.

source: He required no other host, and this unique dream usually proceeded without any abnormalities.
target: Nullum alium hospitem requīrēbat, et hoc somnium únicum plērūmque sīne anomalīs procedebat.

source: It didn’t appear that anyone needed to constantly monitor it.
target: Non videbātur quod quisquam id constanter observāre debueret.

source: It was important to note that prior to the fire that wiped out Hisoka’s family, the special dream had existed for innumerable years.
target: Notandum erat quod, ante ignem qui familiam Hisoka extinguerat, somnium speciāle per innumerōs annōs exstiverat.

source: The Dream Festival had taken place countless times, yet no one had detected anything amiss.
target: Festum Somniorum innumerōs vītīs factum erat, attamen nemo quidquam inusitātum deprehenderat.

source: Under such conditions, the more individuals who knew the truth, the greater the danger of the information leaking out.
target: Sub his condicionibus, quō plūrēs hominēs veritātem noverunt, ēō maius perīculum erat nē notiātiō effugeret.

source: Nevertheless, Hisoka still enticed Padre Cali and guided him to the black ancient tomb to acquire Beyonder powers.
target: Attamen Hisoka adhūc Padre Cali allicēbat et eum ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum ducebat ut vim Beyonder consequerētur.

source: This anomalous conduct led Lumian to surmise that Hisoka Twanaku had enlisted Padre Cali’s aid in monitoring the dream to verify the status of his dream projection.
target: Haec insolīta agendī rātiōne Lumian coniēcāre coepit Hisoka Twanaku auxilium Padre Cali ad somnium observandum, ut statum proiēctiōnis somnī confirmāret, petīvisse.

source: The dream projection would gradually dissipate as Hisoka departed Tizamo, ultimately vanishing altogether.
target: Proiēctiō somnī paulatim evanescere coepit, cum Hisoka Tizamo relinqueret, tandem omnīnō evanescens.

source: If Hisoka desired its continued existence, he would need to return for a time after it had faded to a certain point.
target: Sī Hisoka eius existentiam continuātam dēsirāvisset, necesse habuīsset ut aliquō tempore redīret postquam ad certum gradum evanuerit.

source: Given that the dreams surrounding the black boulder were typically in a state of disarray, the rate at which the dream projection dissipated might be erratic.
target: Cum somnia circa saepem nigrum plērūmque in statu perturbātō essent, celeritas qua proiēctiō somnī evanueret incerta esse poterat.

source: This necessitated daily monitoring.
target: Hoc quōtidianam vigilantiam postulābat.

source: As soon as the situation was deemed to have deteriorated, an urgent telegram would be dispatched to summon Hisoka back.
target: Simul ac status putātus esset in deteriorātiōnem, telegramma urgentē mittētur ut Hisoka revocareretur.

source: Naturally, as a Devil, Hisoka would never divulge his true intentions to Padre Cali.
target: Naturāliter, ut Diabolus, Hisoka numquam verās voluntātēs suas Padre Cali divulgāret.

source: He would undoubtedly be on guard against Padre Cali exploiting the dream projection to eliminate this lurking threat.
target: Cērtus erat se vigilandum esse, nē Padre Cali proiēctiōnem somnī ad hanc latentem minimam extrīpandam adhiberet.

source: When instructing Padre Cali on what needed to be done, there was a high probability Hisoka was really having him monitor the shifting dynamics within the dream.
target: Cum Padre Cali de agendīs instituebātur, alta probabilitās erat quō Hisoka revere eum ad mutābiles inter somnium dynamicas observandas compellāret.

source: How could Padre Cali keep tabs on the evolving dream?
target: Quōmodo Padre Cali somnium evolventem observāre posset?

source: Through the dream projections and the condition of the gravekeepers beside the black ancient tomb!
target: Per proiēctiōnēs somnī et condicionem custōdōrum iuxta sepulcrum antiquum nigrum!

source: Regrettably, Lumian couldn’t enter the dream himself.
target: Eheu, Lumian ipse in somnium intrāre nōn poterat.

source: He could only entrust Amandina with questioning Padre Cali.
target: Solum Amandinae committere poterat interrogātiōnem de Padre Cali exercendā.

source: The intelligence gleaned was superficial, not delving into the crux of the matter.
target: Intellēctus perceptus erat superficialis, nōn ad rem penetrālem perveniens.

source: It could merely aid in analysis.
target: Id tantum ad analysim auxiliārī poterat.

source: If he had interrogated Padre Cali directly, he would have been able to roughly ascertain Hisoka’s objective, rather than just harboring suspicions.
target: Sī Padre Cali dīrectē interrogavisset, propositum Hisoka approximatē cognoscere potuisset, potius quam sōlū suspītiōnibus insidisse.

source: At present, the leads concerning the gold and the Demon’s gift both pointed to the black ancient tomb.
target: Praesenti tempore, indicia de aurō atque dōnō dāemōnis ūtrumque ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum referebant.

source: Lumian naturally had to investigate and do what he could.
target: Lumian naturaliter investigāre atque id quod potuīt facere, curāre dēbuīt.

source: If the challenge truly proved insurmountable, he would decisively retreat to Tizamo and conceal himself on the third or fourth floor of the Brieu Motel, allowing the “danger” to confront Ludwig, whose appetite had grown voracious.
target: Sī provocātiō vere insuperābilis evaderet, statim se ad Tizamo retulēret et in tertiō vel quartō tabulātō Brieu Motel se celāret, sinēns "perīculum" Ludwīgum congredī, cuius vorācitas increbuerat.

source: Amandina guided Lumian and the others through the rainforest, drawing near to the boundary of the dream.
target: Amandina Lumian et cēterōs per silvam pluvialem duxit, appropinquantēs ad līmitem somnī.

source: Abruptly, Lumian raised his right hand and whispered, “Stop.”
target: Subitō, Lumian manum dēstrā dextrā attollēns susurrāvit: “Siste.”

source: He sniffed the air, detecting the unmistakable scent of blood.
target: Aeris odōrem olfactus est, sanguinis inconfusum sentiens.

source: With a Reaper’s keen sense of smell and meticulous nature, Lumian could discern that the blood didn’t originate from jungle animals hunting each other.
target: Cum acūtō sensū olfactō et diligenti naturā Reaperī, Lumian discernere potuit sanguinem nōn ex animālibus silvestrīs inter sē venantibus provenīre.

source: It was human blood, rich in spirituality.
target: Sanguis humanus erat, spiritualitātē dīvēs.

source: “What’s wrong?” Amandina asked, taken aback, as if recalling her first venture into this forest with Robert.
target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Amandina, perterritā, quasi prīmam incursiōnem in hanc silvam cum Robert reminiscēns.

source: Camus quickly sensed the problem and pointed in the direction of the blood’s scent.
target: Camus célerrime rem sensit et monstrāvit in partem odōris sanguinis.

source: “Something’s not right over there.”
target: “Aliquid ibi nōn recte se habet.”

source: Insects were gathering in that area.
target: Insecta in illa regione congregābantur.

source: Although Lumian was eager to reach the black ancient tomb to thwart Hisoka’s plan, he knew that the more impatient he felt, the more cautious he needed to be.
target: Quamquam Lumian ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pervenīre ad consilium Hisoka impediendum ardenter studēbat, sciebat quod quanto magis impatiēns se haberet, eo magis cautus esse ōportēbat.

source: He had to remain vigilant of any abnormalities along the way to avoid walking into someone’s trap or missing crucial information and rashly starting a conflict.
target: Debēbat quaelibet in viā anomaliā diligenter observāre, nē in insidiās quisquam incidat aut notitiās maximas omitteret atque imprudenter certāmen inciperet.

source: Aurore had once mentioned that Emperor Roselle might have said that haste makes waste.
target: Aurore olim memorāvit Imperatorem Roselle fortasse dixisse, “Festinātiō vastum ēxitum parit.”

source: Lumian walked towards the source of the blood’s scent at a measured pace.
target: Lumian ad fontem odōris sanguinis passū mensurātō incessit.

source: As he drew closer, he caught a whiff of the pungent odor of blood mingled with decay.
target: Dum propius accessit, odōrem acre sanguinis cum putredine mixtum capiebat.

source: The latter originated from the tranquil essential oil used to repel mosquitoes.
target: Hic alter ex oleō essentiali quietō oriebātur, quod ad culices repellendō adhibētur.

source: Lumian circled a few more trees crawling with poisonous insects and saw a corpse lying face-up on the humus soil.
target: Lumian aliquot arbōrēs, infestātās insectīs venenosis, circumīvit et vidit cadāver facie surrēctō iacēns super solum humicum.

source: The corpse’s eyes were wide open, and its black hair was disheveled.
target: Oculī cadāveris late patebant, et capillī nigrī turbātī erant.

source: Its face was smeared with white paint.
target: Vultus eius albo pittus erat.

source: It was Maslow, the captain of the Tizamo patrol team!
target: Maslow erat, dux turmae custodum Tizamo!

source: At the beginning of the Dream Festival, Maslow, who had “disappeared” behind Lumian, had reappeared in the forest as a corpse!
target: In initiō Festī Somniorum, Maslow, quī post Lumian “evanuerat”, in silva ut cadāver reapparuit!

source: “Maslow!” Camus and Rhea exclaimed in surprise.
target: “Maslow!” inclamāvērunt Camus et Rhea, stupefactī.

source: Before they could fully process their grief, Lumian’s gaze shifted downward as he examined Maslow’s cause of death.
target: Priusquam dolōrem plēnē compresserent, oculī Lumiani deorsum conversī erant, dum causam mortis Maslōvī examināret.

source: The captain of the local patrol team had deep wounds on his chest and abdomen, as if he had been attacked by spears, triangular blades, and other weapons, but the edges showed signs of tearing.
target: Dux turmae localis custodiārum vulnera profunda in pectore et abdomine gerebat, quasi telīs, lamīs triangulīs, aliīsque armīs oppressus esset, sed mārginēs lacerātiōnis indicāverunt.

source: Large amounts of blood had already flowed into the ground, attracting lingering mosquitoes.
target: Magnae copiae sanguinis iam in terram effluērunt, insecta culicum manentia alliciebant.

source: There were obvious signs of decay on Maslow’s body, and a yellowish-green liquid seeped out, as if he had been dead for two to three days.
target: In corpore Maslōvī signa putredinī manifesta erant, ac liquidum virīdēflavum exsudābat, quasi duo ad trēs diēs mortuus esset.

source: After ascertaining the situation on the corpse’s surface and examining the surrounding battle traces, Camus said in a somber voice, “Attacked by the power of the Death domain…”
target: Postquam statum in superficiē cadāveris atque vestigiā proelii circumiecta perspexit, Camus vocē lugubrī dīxit: “Oppressus potestāte Domini Mortis…”

source: Death domain? The image of a cold, middle-aged man in a thin suit suddenly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
target: Dominium Mortis? Imāgō vīrī frigidī, medīe aetātis in tenuē vestītō, subitō in mente Lumiani apparuit.

source: Reaza, the vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol team!
target: Reaza, vice ducis turmae custodum Portus Pylos!

source: He was a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Death pathway!
target: Erat Beyonder mediocris in vīā Mortis!

source: At the beginning of the Dream Festival, Reaza had “disappeared” along with Maslow.
target: In initiō Festī Somniorum, Reaza, una cum Maslōvō, “evanuerat.”

source: Camus glanced at Rhea, who wore a pained expression, and hesitantly said, “They were affected by the Dream Festival and lost control of themselves. They attacked each other. One died, and the other escaped?”
target: Camus Rheam aspexit, quae vultū dolore afflictā esset, et haesitāns dīxit: “Festō Somniorum affectī sunt et se regere nōn poterant. Invicem se aggressī sunt. Unus mortuus est, alter evasit?”

source: This was the most plausible conjecture for the Dream Festival.
target: Haec erat coniēctiō optima de Festō Somniorum.

source: Lumian imagined a similar scene, but he frowned in confusion and said, “Why are they in the jungle?”
target: Lumian talem scenam finxit, sed facie confūsā, dīxit: “Cur in silvā sunt?”

source: Shouldn’t they appear where they were in the real world?
target: Nonne apparērent ubi in mundō rēālī fuerant?

source: In reality, Reaza and Maslow had already returned to Tizamo with me…
target: Rēvēra, Reaza et Maslow iam mecum ad Tizamo redierant…

source: Did something lure them into the forest?
target: Numquid aliquid eōs in silvām attrāxit?

source: As the only member of the Port Pylos patrol team supporting Tizamo, Reaza had known from the beginning that something was amiss here.
target: Reaza, sōlus membrum turmae custodum Portus Pylos qui Tizamo subvenīebat, ab initīo scībat aliquid hic esse inordinātum.

source: Was the true target the black ancient tomb?
target: Fuitne verus finis sepulcrum antiquum nigrum?

source: Lumian looked at Camus and Rhea thoughtfully and casually asked, “Were Maslow and Reaza on good terms?”
target: Lumian Camum et Rheam cogitāns aspexit atque leviter rogāvit: “Erantne Maslow et Reaza in bonīs rēlātiōnibus?”

source: “Excellent terms,” Camus replied with a sigh.
target: “Excellentes rēlātiōnēs,” respondit Camus suspirāns.

source: “Captain Reaza recruited Maslow into the patrol team and provided him with extensive guidance.”
target: “Capitāneus Reaza Maslow in turmam custodum collegit et ei ampliam disciplinam praebuit.”

source: Lumian fell silent for a moment before saying to Amandina and the others, “Let’s continue forward.”
target: Lumian paulisper silentium tenuit, deinde Amandinae et cēterīs dīxit: “Pergāmus.”

source: Rhea and Camus seized the moment to gather some branches to cover Maslow’s corpse.
target: Rhea et Camus occāsiōnem arripērunt ut aliquās rāmās congregarent ad cadāver Maslōvī tegendum.

source: Then, they quickly followed the team.
target: Deinde celeriter turmam secūtī sunt.

source: After walking along the forest path for a while, Amandina suddenly slowed her pace and pressed her hand to the side of her head.
target: Postquam per semitām silvae aliquod tempus ambulāvit, Amandina subitō cursum retardāvit et manum ad lātus capitis apposuit.

source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian asked keenly.
target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Lumian acerrime.

source: Amandina frowned and said, “My head feels a bit heavy, and I’m experiencing hallucinations.”
target: Amandina frontem contrāxit et dīxit: “Caput meum paullō grave videtur, et hallucinātiōnēs experior.”

source: “What kind of hallucinations?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
target: “Quāles hallucinātiōnēs?” inquit Lumian supercilia levāns.

source: Amandina replied in puzzlement, “I saw the black boulder I touched previously—no, the black ancient tomb.
target: Amandina perplexa respondit: “Vidī lapidem nigrum, quem antea tetīgī—immo, sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

source: It felt like I had returned to the past.
target: Sine videbātur quasi ad praeteritum rediīssem.

source: Do you understand?”
target: Intellīgisne?”

source: The past appeared in my mind in the form of an illusion, in front of my eyes, beside my ears.
target: Praeteritum in mente mea apparuit quasi illūsiō, ante ōculos meōs, iuxta aurēs meas.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment before saying, preempting Camus, “Let’s go a little further and see what happens.”
target: Lumian paulisper meditātus, deinde, Camum praeveniēns, dīxit: “Paululō porro pergāmus et videāmus quid fiat.”

source: The hallucinations didn’t incite Amandina’s desire to retreat.
target: Hallucinātiōnēs nōn excitāvērunt Amandinae dēsīderium retrocedendī.

source: With an experimental mindset, she followed the familiar jungle path for another few dozen meters.
target: Mente experimentālī, semitām silvae nōtam per alium vīgintī metra secūtā est.

source: “How is it?” Lumian, who was beside her, inquired.
target: “Quōmodo est?” inquit Lumian, quī iuxta eam stabat.

source: Amandina organized her thoughts and said, “The hallucinations are becoming clearer and more pronounced.”
target: Amandina cogitātiōnēs suās ordināvit et dīxit: “Hallucinātiōnēs magis ac magis clārēscent et eminentius fient.”

source: “The closer you get to the black ancient tomb, the stronger the hallucinations become?” Lumian suggested a possibility before asking, “Did anything similar happen to Robert when he brought you here last time?”
target: “Quō propius ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum accēdis, tanto robustiōrēs hallucīnātiōnēs fient?” inquit Lumian, antequam rogāret: “Evenitne simile Robertō, cum tē hūc ultimō tempore adduxit?”

source: “No,” Amandina replied with certainty. “He was quite normal the entire time.”
target: “Non,” respondit Amandina certē, “Ille totum tempus prōrsus normālis fuit.”

source: Camus speculated, “Perhaps he had already grown accustomed to the hallucinations after approaching more than once.”
target: Camus coniēcit: “Forsitan iam assuēfactus erat hallucīnātiōnibus postquam pluriē accēderat.”

source: “Who knows…” Amandina muttered and looked at Louis Berry. “What should we do now?”
target: “Quis scit…” murmurāvit Amandina et respexit ad Louis Berry. “Quid nōn faciamus?”

source: “It’s not a big deal if it’s just hallucinations…” Lumian pondered for a moment and said, “Let’s continue forward.”
target: “Non est grāve, sī sōlū hallucīnātiōnēs sint…” paulisper meditātus, Lumian dīxit: “Pergāmus.”

source: “Alright.” Amandina wasn’t sure what the hallucinations represented. She endured the discomfort and said, “We’ll reach the ancient tomb in a few minutes.”
target: “Bene.” Amandina nescia erat quid hallucīnātiōnēs repraesentābant. Discommodum tolerāvit et dīxit: “Paucīs momentīs sepulcrum antiquum perveniemus.”

source: She continued forward.
target: Continuāvit.

source: As they walked, Amandina suddenly extended her right hand and pressed it against the forest trees beside her, bending her back.
target: Dum ambulabant, Amandina subitō manum dēstrā dextrā extendit et eam contra arbōrēs silvae iuxta sē apposuit, dorsum flectēns.

source: Without waiting for Lumian to inquire, she recounted the changes in the hallucination and spoke intermittently, “I see myself… after touching the ancient tomb last time… I didn’t… I didn’t fall asleep immediately… I… I was still awake!”
target: Nullo tempore expectāns ut Lumian quaereret, mutātiōnēs hallucīnātiōnis recensuit et intermittinge locūtā est: “Mē ipse video… postquam sepulcrum antiquum tetīgī ultimō tempore… nōn statim obdormīvī… mēr… adhūc vigilābam!”
